title: Specifically pleading special damages
summary: Special-damage pleading identifies losses that require particular notice rather than being sufficiently conveyed by the ordinary consequences of the pleaded wrong. The classification depends on the governing law and the claim.
notes: Do not infer a universal classification of all injuries or damages from one state case. The source uses the case to explore notice and the governing pleading requirement.

sections.Meaning: Special-damage pleading identifies losses that require particular notice rather than being sufficiently conveyed by the ordinary consequences of the pleaded wrong. The classification depends on the governing law and the claim.
sections.How to work through the question: State which loss is sought, why it follows from the wrong, and whether the pleading fairly identifies it. Compare the particular injuries discussed in Ziervogel and consider whether amendment is needed.
